options.misconception: Ne invites agreement or adds a friendly tone at the end of a sentence.

options.text: It is good, is it not said by me.
options.misconception: Ne invites agreement or adds a friendly tone at the end of a sentence.

questions.explanation: In いいですね。 the particle ね has the function of softener or tag. Ne invites agreement or adds a friendly tone at the end of a sentence.
